# Hi, I’m James Healy

I’m a first-year undergraduate **physics student at the University of Bristol**, and I build computational and experimental projects that combine physics, math, and code.

You can explore some of my work below:

## 🚀 Featured Projects

### **GravitySim**
A numerical simulation of the **three-body problem**, written in C#.  
Shows gravitational dynamics between three interacting bodies.

### **OilDropExp**
The complete **Millikan oil drop experiment** report from first-year labs — with data analysis code in Python and the final formal write-up included.

### **ArtifactCode**
C# code developed as part of my **Extended Project Qualification (EPQ)** along with the written essay.
